caption: Same-sample arterial PCO₂ and pH at the fixed index encounter. Both endpoints use identical paired samples, patients, adjustment and primary numeric BMI spline basis. PaCO₂ ≥45 mm Hg defines paired hypercapnia; adding pH <7.35 on the same sample defines the narrower endpoint. Curves standardize to the shared outcome-evaluable primary population, with pointwise model-based 95% intervals; dotted segments mark sparse support. The lower panel counts paired patients by original BMI. Pairing availability and unknown evidence are reported separately. No supplemental PIF is calculated. Unavailable or failed estimates remain empty, not zero. Requiring a valid pair adds selection. Acidemia does not establish acute respiratory failure; absence does not establish compensation. Samples may follow treatment. Crossing curves require scientific review.
